This video misses something very important; augmentation is not infinite. The word processor made more writing jobs, but who's reading all the millions of trash novels that come out every year? The 3d printer enabled you to make a prop for your video, which is now one of ten thousand uploaded on this very topic just today. While people are struggling to break away from the infinite content on social media, the number of influencers increases exponentially, all competing for a smaller and smaller piece of humanity's collective attention. Now we can make anything, but who are we making it for? Temu is stuffed with products nobody needs, being advertised on platforms people want to quit, while the working class desperately try and invent new jobs nobody asked them to do because we still need to earn money. Elevator operators disappeared because elevators can't be improved any more, we stopped needing them to be better. Maybe a company will come along offering smart AI elevators with no buttons, but it won't be better, people are just at the stage of inventing solutions to problems that don't exist so that they don't starve.
